# Web hooks

The commands `mt help` lists under Web hooks. More in [Runs and events](../../../concepts/runs-and-events.md#3-get-called-back-webhooks).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`webhook-delete`](#webhook-delete) | Delete a webhook, by `--id` or by `--type` and `--url` |
| [`webhook-delivery-list`](#webhook-delivery-list) | List a webhook's recent deliveries, newest first: delivered, retrying or failed, and why (delivered ones are kept 24 hours, failures 7 days) |
| [`webhook-get`](#webhook-get) | List the tenant's webhooks: the type, URL and id of each |
| [`webhook-set`](#webhook-set) | Register a webhook, or update the one already registered for the same type and URL |

## webhook-delete

Delete a webhook, by `--id` or by `--type` and `--url`.

```text
mt webhook-delete [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--id <id>` | id |  |  | The webhook's id (from webhook-get) |
| `--type, -t <value>` | text |  |  | With `--url`, the webhook's type: InteractionProcess, AppProcess, CapsuleProcess, CodePipelineProcess, IngestedFile or Billing |
| `--url, -u <value>` | text |  |  | With `--type`, the webhook's URL |

## webhook-delivery-list

List a webhook's recent deliveries, newest first: delivered, retrying or failed, and why (delivered ones are kept 24 hours, failures 7 days).

```text
mt webhook-delivery-list <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The webhook's id (from webhook-get) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit, -l <number>` | whole number |  | `50` | Maximum number of deliveries to list (1-200) |

## webhook-get

List the tenant's webhooks: the type, URL and id of each.

```text
mt webhook-get
```

## webhook-set

Register a webhook, or update the one already registered for the same type and URL.

```text
mt webhook-set [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type, -t <value>` | text | yes |  | What it is called about: InteractionProcess, AppProcess, CapsuleProcess, CodePipelineProcess, IngestedFile or Billing (case matters) |
| `--url, -u <value>` | text | yes |  | The http or https URL deliveries are sent to |
| `--secret, -s <value>` | text | yes |  | The secret every delivery is signed with, so your server can check it came from Maitento |
| `--signed-only` | flag |  |  | For a webhook registered before deliveries were signed: stop sending its secret in a header, and only sign (no undo; new webhooks are always signed only) |
